imagery: The live site has real stock photos: a black hero, a delivery man with boxes at a white cargo van, a man in front of an orange semi cab, a box truck on a phone map, and warehouse shots. The new blue signature and bid kit use a 3D chrome Sprinter-style cargo van with blue glow accents.
tagline: Fast Freight. Clear Pricing. Seamless Service.
design_notes: Three palettes exist. The current Oct-2026 brand is navy #0b2e5b plus electric blue #007bff with the chrome van (Vika's brandbook, which is not stored locally; the hex values come from memory notes and match pixels in the blue bid template on the Desktop). The live site still runs an orange #ff6725 Tilda template with a navy #294a7b speed-line van logo, and the 2024 Albatross brandbook and portal logo are lavender #a490ff. Use the blue brand with a speed-lined cargo van, and avoid lavender and orange.
